name: zombie-mermaid

tools.name: render_mermaid_svg
tools.description: Render Mermaid diagram source to a self-contained SVG string. Supports flowcharts, state diagrams, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, ER diagrams, and XY charts. Optional bg/fg hex colors override the theme. Optional outputPath writes the SVG to a .svg file inside the server's working directory and returns { saved, size } instead of the SVG text.

diagram.description: Mermaid diagram source text, e.g. "graph TD\n  A --> B". Supports flowcharts, state diagrams, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, ER diagrams, and XY charts.

theme.description: Built-in theme name. One of: zinc-light, zinc-dark, tokyo-night, tokyo-night-storm, tokyo-night-light, catppuccin-mocha, catppuccin-latte, nord, nord-light, dracula, github-light, github-dark, solarized-light, solarized-dark, one-dark

transparent.description: Render with a transparent background instead of the theme background color. Default: false.

font.description: Font family for diagram text. Default: "Inter".

bg.description: Background color override as hex (#rgb or #rrggbb). Applied on top of the theme.

fg.description: Foreground/text color override as hex (#rgb or #rrggbb). Applied on top of the theme.

outputPath.description: Write the SVG to this file instead of returning it, and return { saved, size } (absolute path, bytes). Must end in .svg and resolve inside the MCP server's working directory; the parent directory must already exist; symlinks and non-regular files are refused. An existing .svg file at the path is overwritten.

tools.name: render_mermaid_ascii
tools.description: Render Mermaid diagram source to a plain-text ASCII or Unicode box-drawing diagram, suitable for a terminal or a chat/agent context. Supports flowcharts, state diagrams, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, and ER diagrams.

diagram.description: Mermaid diagram source text, e.g. "graph LR\n  A --> B". Supports flowcharts, state diagrams, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, and ER diagrams.

useAscii.description: true = plain ASCII characters (+, -, |, >); false/unset = Unicode box-drawing characters (┌, ─, │, ►). Default: false.

paddingX.description: Horizontal spacing between nodes. Default: 5. Flowchart/state diagrams only.

paddingY.description: Vertical spacing between nodes. Default: 5. Flowchart/state diagrams only.

boxBorderPadding.description: Padding inside node boxes. Default: 1. Flowchart/state diagrams only.

annotations.title: Render Mermaid diagram to ASCII/Unicode art

tools.name: check_mermaid_sequence_activations
tools.description: Check a Mermaid sequence diagram for activation/deactivation imbalance: every "activate X" (or "+" arrow shorthand) must be closed by a matching "deactivate X" ("-" shorthand). Returns a JSON report ({ ok, issues }) rather than rendering anything. Mechanical and deterministic — no LLM judgment involved. Only sequence diagrams are supported.

diagram.description: Mermaid sequence diagram source text, e.g. "sequenceDiagram\n  A->>+B: hi\n  B-->>-A: bye". Must start with "sequenceDiagram" — this tool does not check other diagram types.

annotations.title: Check Mermaid sequence diagram activation balance

tools.name: fix_mermaid_sequence_activations
tools.description: Check a Mermaid sequence diagram for activation/deactivation imbalance and, where mechanically safe, return a corrected version: a dangling "activate X" (or "+" shorthand) with no matching "deactivate X" gets one appended. An unmatched "deactivate X" with nothing open is reported but not auto-fixed (no safe, unambiguous edit exists without source-position tracking). Returns a JSON report ({ ok, fixedDiagram, fixesApplied, remainingIssues }) rather than rendering anything. Mechanical and deterministic — no LLM judgment involved. Only sequence diagrams are supported.

diagram.description: Mermaid sequence diagram source text, e.g. "sequenceDiagram\n  activate A\n  A->>B: hi". Must start with "sequenceDiagram" — this tool does not check other diagram types.

annotations.title: Fix Mermaid sequence diagram activation balance

tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: List the names of the built-in themes accepted by the `theme` argument of render_mermaid_svg.

tools.name: list_diagram_types
tools.description: List the Mermaid diagram types this library detects and renders (flowchart also covers state diagrams).
